responses.response: I had not seen the pricing survey. Contracted pricing softens the effect but 11% is too low; I will move toward the survey range.
Concentration is real, but the self-build is a 2028 event and current contracts run multiple years. I keep 88% for the base case and lower the bear case.
The 9.25% coupon is a debt cost; with ~50% debt weighting 10.5% is defensible.
